invariants_created: EHLO or HELO MUST be the first client command after receiving the 220 banner, and MUST precede MAIL FROM.
MAIL FROM MUST precede RCPT TO in every mail transaction.
RCPT TO MUST precede DATA, and at least one successful RCPT TO is required before DATA.
RCPT TO can be repeated multiple times before DATA to specify multiple recipients.
AUTH MUST follow EHLO (not HELO), as extensions are only advertised after EHLO.
STARTTLS MUST follow EHLO and MUST precede AUTH or MAIL FROM.
RSET returns the session to the post-greeting (GREETED) state without closing the connection, allowing a new MAIL FROM to be issued.
After a completed DATA (message sent), a new MAIL FROM can be issued to start a new transaction without requiring a new EHLO.
NOOP and VRFY can be issued at any point after the greeting without affecting the current transaction state.
The server sends a 220 banner upon connection before any client command. The client must wait for this banner before sending EHLO/HELO.
After DATA command, the server responds 354 and the client must send message content terminated by a line containing only '.' before any further SMTP commands.
A rejected RCPT TO (550) does not abort the transaction; additional RCPT TO commands or DATA may follow.
EHLO.hostname: Required. Must be a valid hostname or FQDN of the client system. Cannot be empty.
HELO.hostname: Required. Must be a valid hostname or FQDN of the client system. Cannot be empty.
MAIL.sender: Required. Must be enclosed in angle brackets (e.g., <sender@domain>). May be empty reverse-path (<>) for bounce/DSN messages. Must contain a valid email address or be empty.
RCPT.recipient: Required. Must be enclosed in angle brackets (e.g., <recipient@domain>). Must contain a valid email address. At least one RCPT TO with a 250 response is required before DATA.
AUTH.mechanism: Required. Must be one of the SASL mechanisms advertised by the server in the EHLO response (commonly PLAIN, LOGIN, or CRAM-MD5). AUTH is only valid after EHLO, not HELO.
AUTH.initial-response: Optional. Base64-encoded initial authentication data. Depends on the SASL mechanism in use.
VRFY.address: Required. Must be a mailbox address to verify. Often disabled by servers for security reasons.
EXPN.list: Required. Must be a mailing list name to expand. Often disabled by servers for security/privacy reasons.

DATA.body: Message content follows the DATA command after receiving 354 response. Must be terminated by a line containing only a single period (.). Lines beginning with '.' in the original content must be dot-stuffed (prefixed with an extra '.').
MAIL.command_keyword: Must be 'MAIL FROM:' (case-insensitive). The colon is required.
RCPT.command_keyword: Must be 'RCPT TO:' (case-insensitive). The colon is required.
